## Problem

What limitation or missing capability are you hitting?

## Proposed solution

How would you like it to work? Show a tool name, JSON input, and expected output.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you have considered and why this one is better.

## Use case

What scenario triggered this request? (One or two real-world examples are great.)

## Scope

- [ ] Affects existing public tool (breaking change)
- [ ] New tool only
- [ ] Configuration only
- [ ] Documentation only
